---
title: "processed_data"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

alaska <- read.csv("../raw/_alaska-attributes.csv")
arc_canN <- read.csv("../raw/_arctic_canada_north-attributes.csv")
arc_canS <- read.csv("../raw/_arctic_canada_south-attributes.csv")
gln_per <- read.csv("../raw/_greenland_periphery-attributes.csv")
wCanUS <- read.csv("../raw/_western_canada_usa-attributes.csv")
```

```{r}
glaciers <- alaska |> 
  full_join(arc_canN) |> 
  full_join(arc_canS) |> 
  full_join(gln_per) |> 
  full_join(wCanUS) |> 
  mutate(center_longitude = cenlon,
         center_latitude = cenlat,
         minimum_elevation = zmin_m,
         maximum_elevation = zmax_m,
         median_elevation = zmed_m,
         mean_elevation = zmean_m,
         maximum_length = lmax_m) |> 
  select(-glims_id, -o1region, -o2region, -rgi_id, -anlys_id, -subm_id, -surge_type, -term_type, -conn_lvl, -primeclass, -glac_name, -src_date, -cenlon, -cenlat, -is_rgi6, -termlon, -termlat, -zmin_m, -zmax_m, -zmed_m, -zmean_m, -lmax_m, -dem_source)
write_csv(glaciers, "glaciers.csv")
```
